content: Next.js single-domain multi-tenant: tenant resolution must precede routing, data, caching, metadata decisions. Runtime values (cookies/headers) cannot be passed into 'use cache' functions; ISR/full route cache is keyed by path so a cached page or generateMetadata output for one tenant is served to all tenants on the same path. Cache keys must include tenantId; 'undefined:key' typo style bugs share entries across tenants (dev.to multi-tenancy leaks IRL). Sources: next.js discussions #45457 #85239 #20841, johnkavanagh multi-tenant article.
